fix.summary: Placement temporary is named .hoi4ms-placing-<txid>-<op>.tmp (locks and rollback steps use the same derivation); rollback removes forward and rollback-transaction temporaries before restoring; a named placement replaces its own stale regular file and refuses links and non-regular entries.
fix.covered_extra_gap: temporary left when rollback itself is killed mid-write (retry replaces and cleans it)
left_as_follow_up: empty directories created by an operation beside its destination (only plan.transaction.directories is journaled; needs a journal change)
placement temporaries of operations outside the project root (external)
stale temporaries are removed by rollback only, not by forward resume

regression_test.name: transaction::tests::hard_stop_before_a_placement_rename_is_recovered_without_leftovers
regression_test.method: child process aborts (std::process::abort) at the numbered caller-named placement via cfg(test) hook HOI4_MOD_SETUP_TEST_ABORT_PLACEMENT; parent asserts a .hoi4ms- file was left, runs find_incomplete_transaction + rollback_transaction, requires path+bytes inventory equal to pre-apply and no .hoi4ms- file

fails_without_fix.how: local revert of the temporary-name derivation to a random uuid name; rollback cleanup neutralized by the random name. Not a run of literal origin/main because the abort hook lives in the changed function.
